subject: ADHD word-count: feedback_correct over 12 words in RP5/RP6/RP7 Q14
body:
GR — new JSON Schema validator (validate-exam-schema.cjs) flagged 3 ADHD guideline warnings:

- retake-practice-5.json Q14 (rp5-q14): feedback_correct is 13 words. ADHD max is 12.
- retake-practice-6.json Q14 (rp6-q14): feedback_correct is 13 words. ADHD max is 12.
- retake-practice-7.json Q14 (rp7-q14): feedback_correct is 16 words. ADHD max is 12.

These are warnings, not hard failures — the CI gate still passes. But per .voice-guide.md feedback strings must be max 12 words for Kai's ADHD.

All other schema checks pass: 9/9 exams OK on required fields, types, enums, graph structure.

Fix when you get to it — not urgent. No action needed from me.
